WITH SEMANA AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC(d, WEEK(SUNDAY))                                             AS semana_inicio,
    DATE_ADD(DATE_TRUNC(d, WEEK(SUNDAY)), INTERVAL 6 DAY)                  AS semana_fin,
    CONCAT('W', LPAD(CAST(DATE_DIFF(DATE_TRUNC(d, WEEK(SUNDAY)),
      DATE '2025-12-28', WEEK) + 1 AS STRING), 2, '0'),
      '-', CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d) AS STRING))                           AS semana_fiscal
  FROM UNNEST(GENERATE_DATE_ARRAY(
    DATE_TRUNC(DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 28 DAY), WEEK(SUNDAY)),
    DATE_TRUNC(CURRENT_DATE(), WEEK(SUNDAY)),
    INTERVAL 1 WEEK
  )) AS d
)
SELECT
  S.semana_fiscal,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(
    SUM(IF(L.PROCESS = 'putaway', L.UNITS, 0)),
    SUM(L.TIEMPO_SISTEMICO + L.TIEMPO_NO_SISTEMICO + L.TND + L.EXTENDED_IDLE_TIME)
  )                                                                         AS INP,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(
    SUM(IF(L.PROCESS IN ('checkin','direct_checkin'), L.UNITS, 0)),
    SUM(IF(L.PROCESS IN ('checkin','direct_checkin'),
      L.TIEMPO_SISTEMICO + L.TIEMPO_NO_SISTEMICO + L.TND + L.EXTENDED_IDLE_TIME, 0))
  )                                                                         AS TPH_CH_DCI,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(
    SUM(IF(L.PROCESS = 'putaway', L.UNITS, 0)),
    SUM(IF(L.PROCESS = 'putaway',
      L.TIEMPO_SISTEMICO + L.TIEMPO_NO_SISTEMICO + L.TND + L.EXTENDED_IDLE_TIME, 0))
  )                                                                         AS TPH_PUTAWAY,
  SUM(IF(L.PROCESS IN ('checkin','direct_checkin'), L.UNITS, 0))           AS UNID_CH_DCI,
  SUM(IF(L.PROCESS = 'putaway', L.UNITS, 0))                               AS UNID_PUTAWAY,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(
    SUM(IF(L.PROCESS = 'receiving', L.UNITS, 0)),
    SUM(IF(L.PROCESS = 'receiving',
      L.TIEMPO_SISTEMICO + L.TIEMPO_NO_SISTEMICO + L.TND + L.EXTENDED_IDLE_TIME, 0))
  )                                                                         AS NETA_RECEIVING,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(
    SUM(IF(L.PROCESS = 'checkin', L.UNITS, 0)),
    SUM(IF(L.PROCESS = 'checkin',
      L.TIEMPO_SISTEMICO + L.TIEMPO_NO_SISTEMICO + L.TND + L.EXTENDED_IDLE_TIME, 0))
  )                                                                         AS NETA_CHECKIN,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(
    SUM(IF(L.PROCESS = 'direct_checkin', L.UNITS, 0)),
    SUM(IF(L.PROCESS = 'direct_checkin',
      L.TIEMPO_SISTEMICO + L.TIEMPO_NO_SISTEMICO + L.TND + L.EXTENDED_IDLE_TIME, 0))
  )                                                                         AS NETA_DCI,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(
    SUM(IF(L.PROCESS = 'putaway', L.UNITS, 0)),
    SUM(IF(L.PROCESS = 'putaway',
      L.TIEMPO_SISTEMICO + L.TIEMPO_NO_SISTEMICO + L.TND + L.EXTENDED_IDLE_TIME, 0))
  )                                                                         AS NETA_PUTAWAY,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(
    SUM(IF(L.PROCESS = 'direct_checkin', L.UNITS, 0)),
    SUM(IF(L.PROCESS IN ('checkin','direct_checkin'), L.UNITS, 0))
  ) * 100                                                                   AS SHARE_DCI,
  MAX(IF(L.PROCESS = 'putaway',        L.TARGET_AREA_PNET,                NULL)) AS TARGET_INP,
  MAX(IF(L.PROCESS = 'receiving',      L.TARGET_PROCESS_NET_PRODUCTIVITY,  NULL)) AS TARGET_NETA_RECEIVING,
  MAX(IF(L.PROCESS = 'checkin',        L.TARGET_PROCESS_NET_PRODUCTIVITY,  NULL)) AS TARGET_NETA_CHECKIN,
  MAX(IF(L.PROCESS = 'direct_checkin', L.TARGET_PROCESS_NET_PRODUCTIVITY,  NULL)) AS TARGET_NETA_DCI,
  MAX(IF(L.PROCESS = 'putaway',        L.TARGET_PROCESS_NET_PRODUCTIVITY,  NULL)) AS TARGET_NETA_PUTAWAY
FROM `your-project.source.OPERATOR_PRODUCTIVITY` L
JOIN SEMANA S
  ON DATE(L.START_DATE) BETWEEN S.semana_inicio AND S.semana_fin
WHERE L.LOGISTIC_CENTER_ID = 'CD-01'
  AND L.AREA = 'inbound'
  AND DATE(L.START_DATE) >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 28 DAY)
  AND DATE(L.START_DATE) < CURRENT_DATE()
GROUP BY S.semana_fiscal
ORDER BY S.semana_fiscal DESC

WITH
SEMANA AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC(d, WEEK(SUNDAY))                                             AS semana_inicio,
    DATE_ADD(DATE_TRUNC(d, WEEK(SUNDAY)), INTERVAL 6 DAY)                  AS semana_fin,
    CONCAT('W', LPAD(CAST(DATE_DIFF(DATE_TRUNC(d, WEEK(SUNDAY)),
      DATE '2025-12-28', WEEK) + 1 AS STRING), 2, '0'),
      '-', CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d) AS STRING))                           AS semana_fiscal
  FROM UNNEST(GENERATE_DATE_ARRAY(
    DATE_TRUNC(DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 28 DAY), WEEK(SUNDAY)),
    DATE_TRUNC(CURRENT_DATE(), WEEK(SUNDAY)),
    INTERVAL 1 WEEK
  )) AS d
),
SLA_D AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC(DATE(START_DATE), WEEK(SUNDAY))            AS semana_inicio,
    SUM(NUMERATOR)                                        AS SLA_NUMERATOR,
    SUM(DENOMINATOR)                                      AS SLA_DENOMINATOR,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(NUMERATOR), SUM(DENOMINATOR))         AS SLA_PCT
  FROM `your-project.source.INBOUND_SLA`
  WHERE WAREHOUSE_ID = 'CD-01'
    AND DATE(START_DATE) >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 28 DAY)
    AND DATE(START_DATE) < CURRENT_DATE()
  GROUP BY 1
),
REA_D AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC(DATE(R.FECHA_REAPERTURA), WEEK(SUNDAY))    AS semana_inicio,
    SUM(IF(R.ESTADO_EXC = 'FUERA DE 48h', 1, 0))         AS REAPERTURAS_FUERA_SLA,
    MAX(I.INB)                                            AS INB_TOTALES,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(
      SUM(IF(R.ESTADO_EXC = 'FUERA DE 48h', 1, 0)),
      MAX(I.INB)
    )                                                     AS PCT_REAPERTURAS
  FROM `your-project.cx.REOPENINGS` R
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
      DATE_TRUNC(DATE(INB_RECEIVED_DATETIME), WEEK(SUNDAY)) AS semana_inicio,
      COUNT(DISTINCT INBOUND_ID)                            AS INB
    FROM `your-project.cx.INBOUND_CONTACTS_AGG`
    WHERE WAREHOUSE = 'CD-01'
      AND DATE(INB_RECEIVED_DATETIME) >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 28 DAY)
    GROUP BY 1
  ) I ON I.semana_inicio = DATE_TRUNC(DATE(R.FECHA_REAPERTURA), WEEK(SUNDAY))
  WHERE R.WAREHOUSE = 'CD-01'
    AND DATE(R.FECHA_REAPERTURA) >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 28 DAY)
    AND DATE(R.FECHA_REAPERTURA) < CURRENT_DATE()
    AND R.ESTADO_EXC = 'FUERA DE 48h'
  GROUP BY 1
),
DPMO_CRUCE_D AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC(DATE(d.DATE_FINISH), WEEK(SUNDAY))         AS semana_inicio,
    ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(COUNT(1), MAX(p.INBOUND_SKU)) * 1000000, 0) AS DPMO_CRUCE
  FROM `your-project.cx.SKU_CLAIMS` d
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
      DATE_TRUNC(DATE(MIN_ARRIVAL_DATETIME_TZ), WEEK(SUNDAY)) AS semana_inicio,
      COUNT(INBOUND_SKU)                                    AS INBOUND_SKU
    FROM `your-project.cx.SKU_PROCESSED`
    WHERE WAREHOUSE = 'CD-01'
    GROUP BY 1
  ) p ON DATE_TRUNC(DATE(d.DATE_FINISH), WEEK(SUNDAY)) = p.semana_inicio
  WHERE d.WAREHOUSE = 'CD-01'
    AND d.CULPABILIDADE = 'ERROR OPERATIVO'
    AND d.CDU_GROUP IN ('CRUCE SKU','CRUCE IS')
    AND DATE(d.DATE_FINISH) >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 28 DAY)
    AND DATE(d.DATE_FINISH) < CURRENT_DATE()
  GROUP BY 1
),
DPMO_FALT_D AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC(DATE(d.DATE_FINISH), WEEK(SUNDAY))         AS semana_inicio,
    ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(
      COUNT(IF(d.REASON NOT IN ('SIN REAPERTURA','SIN REAPERTURA - FPP'), d.SKU, NULL)),
      MAX(p.INBOUND_SKU)
    ) * 1000000, 0)                                       AS DPMO_FALTANTE
  FROM `your-project.cx.SKU_CLAIMS` d
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
      DATE_TRUNC(DATE(MIN_ARRIVAL_DATETIME_TZ), WEEK(SUNDAY)) AS semana_inicio,
      COUNT(INBOUND_SKU)                                    AS INBOUND_SKU
    FROM `your-project.cx.SKU_PROCESSED`
    WHERE WAREHOUSE = 'CD-01'
    GROUP BY 1
  ) p ON DATE_TRUNC(DATE(d.DATE_FINISH), WEEK(SUNDAY)) = p.semana_inicio
  WHERE d.WAREHOUSE = 'CD-01'
    AND d.CULPABILIDADE = 'ERROR OPERATIVO'
    AND d.CDU_GROUP = 'FALTANTES'
    AND DATE(d.DATE_FINISH) >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 28 DAY)
    AND DATE(d.DATE_FINISH) < CURRENT_DATE()
  GROUP BY 1
),
CR_D AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC(DATE(DATA_ACONTECIMENTO), WEEK(SUNDAY))    AS semana_inicio,
    SUM(CX_CASE_ID)                                       AS SUM_CX_CASE_ID,
    SUM(ENVIOS)                                           AS SUM_ENVIOS,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(CX_CASE_ID), SUM(ENVIOS))             AS CONTACT_RATE
  FROM `your-project.cx.CONTACT_RATE`
  WHERE WAREHOUSE = 'CD-01'
    AND DATE(DATA_ACONTECIMENTO) >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 28 DAY)
    AND DATE(DATA_ACONTECIMENTO) < CURRENT_DATE()
  GROUP BY 1
),
TEO_D AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC(DATE, WEEK(SUNDAY))                        AS semana_inicio,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(
      SUM(IF(PROCESS = 'inbound audit', UNITS_TEO_INB, 0)),
      SUM(UNITS_GNP)
    )                                                     AS TEO_INBOUND_AUDIT
  FROM `your-project.source.TEO_SUMMARY`
  WHERE WAREHOUSE_ID = 'CD-01'
    AND SITE_ID = 'MLC'
    AND DATE >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 28 DAY)
    AND DATE < CURRENT_DATE()
  GROUP BY 1
),
AUD_D AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC(DATE(A.FBM_CREATED_DATE), WEEK(SUNDAY))   AS semana_inicio,
    SUM(A.ERROR_UNITS)                                    AS ERROR_UNITS,
    MAX(P.Unid)                                           AS UNID,
    ROUND(
      SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(A.ERROR_UNITS), MAX(P.Unid)) * 1000000, 0
    )                                                     AS INBOUND_AUDIT
  FROM `your-project.source.INBOUND_AUDIT` A
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
      DATE_TRUNC(DATE(START_DATE), WEEK(SUNDAY))          AS semana_inicio,
      SUM(UNITS)                                          AS Unid
    FROM `your-project.source.EMPLOYEE_ATTRIBUTES`
    WHERE LOGISTIC_CENTER_ID = 'CD-01'
      AND PROCESS    = 'inbound'
      AND SUBPROCESS = 'putaway'
      AND START_DATE >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 28 DAY)
    GROUP BY 1
  ) P ON P.semana_inicio = DATE_TRUNC(DATE(A.FBM_CREATED_DATE), WEEK(SUNDAY))
  WHERE A.WAREHOUSE_ID = 'CD-01'
    AND DATE(A.FBM_CREATED_DATE) >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 28 DAY)
    AND DATE(A.FBM_CREATED_DATE) < CURRENT_DATE()
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
  S.semana_fiscal,
  SLA_D.SLA_PCT,
  SLA_D.SLA_NUMERATOR,
  SLA_D.SLA_DENOMINATOR,
  REA_D.REAPERTURAS_FUERA_SLA,
  REA_D.INB_TOTALES,
  REA_D.PCT_REAPERTURAS,
  DPMO_CRUCE_D.DPMO_CRUCE,
  DPMO_FALT_D.DPMO_FALTANTE,
  CR_D.CONTACT_RATE,
  CR_D.SUM_CX_CASE_ID,
  CR_D.SUM_ENVIOS,
  TEO_D.TEO_INBOUND_AUDIT,
  AUD_D.INBOUND_AUDIT
FROM SEMANA S
LEFT JOIN SLA_D        ON SLA_D.semana_inicio        = S.semana_inicio
LEFT JOIN REA_D        ON REA_D.semana_inicio        = S.semana_inicio
LEFT JOIN DPMO_CRUCE_D ON DPMO_CRUCE_D.semana_inicio = S.semana_inicio
LEFT JOIN DPMO_FALT_D  ON DPMO_FALT_D.semana_inicio  = S.semana_inicio
LEFT JOIN CR_D         ON CR_D.semana_inicio         = S.semana_inicio
LEFT JOIN TEO_D        ON TEO_D.semana_inicio        = S.semana_inicio
LEFT JOIN AUD_D        ON AUD_D.semana_inicio        = S.semana_inicio
ORDER BY S.semana_fiscal DESC

WITH
SEMANA AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC(d, WEEK(SUNDAY))                                             AS semana_inicio,
    DATE_ADD(DATE_TRUNC(d, WEEK(SUNDAY)), INTERVAL 6 DAY)                  AS semana_fin,
    CONCAT('W', LPAD(CAST(DATE_DIFF(DATE_TRUNC(d, WEEK(SUNDAY)),
      DATE '2025-12-28', WEEK) + 1 AS STRING), 2, '0'),
      '-', CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d) AS STRING))                           AS semana_fiscal
  FROM UNNEST(GENERATE_DATE_ARRAY(
    DATE_TRUNC(DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 28 DAY), WEEK(SUNDAY)),
    DATE_TRUNC(CURRENT_DATE(), WEEK(SUNDAY)),
    INTERVAL 1 WEEK
  )) AS d
),
SKU AS (
  SELECT
    INVENTORY_ID,
    CASE WHEN FLAG_TOTABLE = TRUE THEN 'TOTEABLE' ELSE 'NO TOTEABLE' END   AS FLAG_TOTEABLE,
    COALESCE(
      ITE_VOLUMEN,
      CASE
        WHEN ITE_HEIGHT > 0 AND ITE_LENGTH > 0 AND ITE_WIDTH > 0
        THEN ITE_HEIGHT * ITE_LENGTH * ITE_WIDTH / 1000.0
        ELSE NULL
      END
    )                                                                       AS V_LITROS
  FROM `your-project.source.SKU_DETAILS`
  WHERE LOGISTIC_CENTER_ID = 'CD-01'
    AND SIT_SITE_ID        = 'MLC'
  QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
    PARTITION BY INVENTORY_ID
    ORDER BY (ITE_VOLUMEN IS NOT NULL) DESC, (ITE_HEIGHT IS NOT NULL) DESC
  ) = 1
),
OPS AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(OPERATOR_ID AS STRING)  AS OPERATOR_ID,
    DATE(START_DATE)             AS FECHA,
    PROCESS                      AS PROCESO
  FROM `your-project.source.OPERATOR_PRODUCTIVITY`
  WHERE AREA               = 'inbound'
    AND PROCESS            IN ('checkin','direct_checkin')
    AND LOGISTIC_CENTER_ID = 'CD-01'
    AND DATE(START_DATE)   >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 28 DAY)
    AND DATE(START_DATE)   < CURRENT_DATE()
),
VOL_CHK AS (
  SELECT
    'checkin'                                                               AS PROCESO,
    DATE(`your-project.udf.FN_TIMEZONE`('MLC', m.AUD_INS_DTTM)) AS FECHA,
    ROUND(SUM(m.FBM_QUANTITY * s.V_LITROS), 1)                             AS VOL_L_TOTAL,
    ROUND(SUM(IF(IFNULL(s.FLAG_TOTEABLE,'NO TOTEABLE') = 'TOTEABLE',
      m.FBM_QUANTITY * s.V_LITROS, NULL)), 1)                              AS VOL_L_TOTEABLE,
    ROUND(SUM(IF(IFNULL(s.FLAG_TOTEABLE,'NO TOTEABLE') = 'NO TOTEABLE',
      m.FBM_QUANTITY * s.V_LITROS, NULL)), 1)                              AS VOL_L_NO_TOTEABLE,
    SUM(IF(IFNULL(s.FLAG_TOTEABLE,'NO TOTEABLE') = 'TOTEABLE',
      m.FBM_QUANTITY, 0))                                                  AS UDS_TOTEABLE,
    SUM(IF(IFNULL(s.FLAG_TOTEABLE,'NO TOTEABLE') = 'NO TOTEABLE',
      m.FBM_QUANTITY, 0))                                                  AS UDS_NO_TOTEABLE,
    SUM(m.FBM_QUANTITY)                                                    AS UDS_TOTALES
  FROM `your-project.source.STOCK_MOVEMENTS` m
  INNER JOIN OPS ops
    ON  ops.OPERATOR_ID = CAST(m.FBM_USER_ID AS STRING)
    AND ops.FECHA = DATE(`your-project.udf.FN_TIMEZONE`('MLC', m.AUD_INS_DTTM))
    AND ops.PROCESO = 'checkin'
  LEFT JOIN SKU s ON s.INVENTORY_ID = m.INVENTORY_ID
  WHERE m.WAREHOUSE_ID       = 'CD-01'
    AND m.FBM_REASON_PROCESS = 'inbound'
    AND m.ADDRESS_FROM       IS NULL
    AND m.ADDRESS_TO         LIKE 'MU-%'
    AND m.AUD_INS_DTTM >= DATETIME(TIMESTAMP(DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 28 DAY), 'America/Santiago'))
    AND m.AUD_INS_DTTM <  DATETIME(TIMESTAMP(CURRENT_DATE(), 'America/Santiago'))
  GROUP BY FECHA
),
VOL_DCI AS (
  SELECT
    'direct_checkin'                                                        AS PROCESO,
    DATE(`your-project.udf.FN_TIMEZONE`('MLC', m.AUD_INS_DTTM)) AS FECHA,
    ROUND(SUM(m.FBM_QUANTITY * s.V_LITROS), 1)                             AS VOL_L_TOTAL,
    ROUND(SUM(IF(IFNULL(s.FLAG_TOTEABLE,'NO TOTEABLE') = 'TOTEABLE',
      m.FBM_QUANTITY * s.V_LITROS, NULL)), 1)                              AS VOL_L_TOTEABLE,
    ROUND(SUM(IF(IFNULL(s.FLAG_TOTEABLE,'NO TOTEABLE') = 'NO TOTEABLE',
      m.FBM_QUANTITY * s.V_LITROS, NULL)), 1)                              AS VOL_L_NO_TOTEABLE,
    SUM(IF(IFNULL(s.FLAG_TOTEABLE,'NO TOTEABLE') = 'TOTEABLE',
      m.FBM_QUANTITY, 0))                                                  AS UDS_TOTEABLE,
    SUM(IF(IFNULL(s.FLAG_TOTEABLE,'NO TOTEABLE') = 'NO TOTEABLE',
      m.FBM_QUANTITY, 0))                                                  AS UDS_NO_TOTEABLE,
    SUM(m.FBM_QUANTITY)                                                    AS UDS_TOTALES
  FROM `your-project.source.STOCK_MOVEMENTS` m
  INNER JOIN OPS ops
    ON  ops.OPERATOR_ID = CAST(m.FBM_USER_ID AS STRING)
    AND ops.FECHA = DATE(`your-project.udf.FN_TIMEZONE`('MLC', m.AUD_INS_DTTM))
    AND ops.PROCESO = 'direct_checkin'
  LEFT JOIN SKU s ON s.INVENTORY_ID = m.INVENTORY_ID
  WHERE m.WAREHOUSE_ID       = 'CD-01'
    AND m.FBM_REASON_PROCESS = 'inbound'
    AND m.ADDRESS_FROM       IS NULL
    AND m.ADDRESS_TO         LIKE 'MU-%'
    AND m.AUD_INS_DTTM >= DATETIME(TIMESTAMP(DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 28 DAY), 'America/Santiago'))
    AND m.AUD_INS_DTTM <  DATETIME(TIMESTAMP(CURRENT_DATE(), 'America/Santiago'))
  GROUP BY FECHA
),
VOL_PA AS (
  SELECT
    'putaway'                                                               AS PROCESO,
    DATE(m.FBM_CREATED_DATE)                                               AS FECHA,
    ROUND(SUM(m.FBM_QUANTITY * s.V_LITROS), 1)                             AS VOL_L_TOTAL,
    ROUND(SUM(IF(IFNULL(s.FLAG_TOTEABLE,'NO TOTEABLE') = 'TOTEABLE',
      m.FBM_QUANTITY * s.V_LITROS, NULL)), 1)                              AS VOL_L_TOTEABLE,
    ROUND(SUM(IF(IFNULL(s.FLAG_TOTEABLE,'NO TOTEABLE') = 'NO TOTEABLE',
      m.FBM_QUANTITY * s.V_LITROS, NULL)), 1)                              AS VOL_L_NO_TOTEABLE,
    SUM(IF(IFNULL(s.FLAG_TOTEABLE,'NO TOTEABLE') = 'TOTEABLE',
      m.FBM_QUANTITY, 0))                                                  AS UDS_TOTEABLE,
    SUM(IF(IFNULL(s.FLAG_TOTEABLE,'NO TOTEABLE') = 'NO TOTEABLE',
      m.FBM_QUANTITY, 0))                                                  AS UDS_NO_TOTEABLE,
    SUM(m.FBM_QUANTITY)                                                    AS UDS_TOTALES
  FROM `your-project.source.STOCK_MOVEMENTS` m
  LEFT JOIN SKU s ON s.INVENTORY_ID = m.INVENTORY_ID
  WHERE m.WAREHOUSE_ID       = 'CD-01'
    AND m.FBM_REASON_PROCESS = 'put_away'
    AND DATE(m.FBM_CREATED_DATE) >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 28 DAY)
    AND DATE(m.FBM_CREATED_DATE) <  CURRENT_DATE()
    AND m.FBM_QUANTITY > 0
  GROUP BY FECHA
),
VOL_ALL AS (
  SELECT * FROM VOL_CHK
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM VOL_DCI
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM VOL_PA
)
SELECT
  S.semana_fiscal,
  V.FECHA,
  V.PROCESO,
  V.UDS_TOTALES,
  V.UDS_TOTEABLE,
  V.UDS_NO_TOTEABLE,
  V.VOL_L_TOTAL,
  V.VOL_L_TOTEABLE,
  V.VOL_L_NO_TOTEABLE,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(V.UDS_TOTEABLE, V.UDS_TOTALES) * 100, 1)              AS PCT_TOTEABLE,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(V.VOL_L_TOTAL, V.UDS_TOTALES), 3)                     AS VOL_POND_TOTAL
FROM VOL_ALL V
JOIN SEMANA S
  ON V.FECHA BETWEEN S.semana_inicio AND S.semana_fin
ORDER BY V.FECHA DESC, V.PROCESO

WITH SEMANA AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC(d, WEEK(SUNDAY))                                             AS semana_inicio,
    DATE_ADD(DATE_TRUNC(d, WEEK(SUNDAY)), INTERVAL 6 DAY)                  AS semana_fin,
    CONCAT('W', LPAD(CAST(DATE_DIFF(DATE_TRUNC(d, WEEK(SUNDAY)),
      DATE '2025-12-28', WEEK) + 1 AS STRING), 2, '0'),
      '-', CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d) AS STRING))                           AS semana_fiscal
  FROM UNNEST(GENERATE_DATE_ARRAY(
    DATE_TRUNC(DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 28 DAY), WEEK(SUNDAY)),
    DATE_TRUNC(CURRENT_DATE(), WEEK(SUNDAY)),
    INTERVAL 1 WEEK
  )) AS d
)
SELECT
  S.semana_fiscal,
  DATE(A.START_DATE)                                                        AS FECHA,
  SUM(CASE
    WHEN A.HIRING_DATE = false
    AND A.ROL IN ('rep','team_lead')
    AND A.AT_NET IS NOT NULL
    THEN A.NET_WORK_DURATION ELSE 0
  END)                                                                      AS AT_NUMERADOR,
  SUM(CASE
    WHEN A.HIRING_DATE = false
    AND A.ROL IN ('rep','team_lead')
    AND A.AT_NET IS NOT NULL
    THEN A.TARGET_DURATION ELSE 0
  END)                                                                      AS AT_DENOMINADOR,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(
    SUM(CASE
      WHEN A.HIRING_DATE = false
      AND A.ROL IN ('rep','team_lead')
      AND A.AT_NET IS NOT NULL
      THEN A.NET_WORK_DURATION ELSE 0
    END),
    SUM(CASE
      WHEN A.HIRING_DATE = false
      AND A.ROL IN ('rep','team_lead')
      AND A.AT_NET IS NOT NULL
      THEN A.TARGET_DURATION ELSE 0
    END)
  )                                                                         AS AT_PCT
FROM `your-project.source.AVAILABLE_TIME` A
JOIN SEMANA S
  ON DATE(A.START_DATE) BETWEEN S.semana_inicio AND S.semana_fin
WHERE A.LOGISTIC_CENTER_ID = 'CD-01'
  AND A.AREA               = 'inbound_fbm'
  AND DATE(A.START_DATE)   >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 28 DAY)
  AND DATE(A.START_DATE)   < CURRENT_DATE()
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY FECHA DESC

WITH SEMANA AS (

      DATE '2025-12-28', WEEK) + 1 AS STRING), 2, '0'),
      '-', CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d) AS STRING))                           AS semana_fiscal
  FROM UNNEST(GENERATE_DATE_ARRAY(
    DATE_TRUNC(DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 28 DAY), WEEK(SUNDAY)),
    DATE_TRUNC(CURRENT_DATE(), WEEK(SUNDAY)),
    INTERVAL 1 WEEK
  )) AS d
)
SELECT
  S.semana_fiscal,
  DATE(L.START_DATE)                                                       AS FECHA,

  -- INP = unidades putaway / NET_HH TOTAL del area inbound
  SAFE_DIVIDE(
    SUM(IF(L.PROCESS = 'putaway', L.UNITS, 0)),
    SUM(L.TIEMPO_SISTEMICO + L.TIEMPO_NO_SISTEMICO + L.TND + L.EXTENDED_IDLE_TIME)
  )                                                                         AS INP,

  -- Unidades CH + DCI
  SUM(IF(L.PROCESS IN ('checkin','direct_checkin'), L.UNITS, 0))           AS UNID_CH_DCI,

  -- Unidades Putaway
  SUM(IF(L.PROCESS = 'putaway', L.UNITS, 0))                               AS UNID_PUTAWAY,

  -- Neta Receiving
  SAFE_DIVIDE(
    SUM(IF(L.PROCESS = 'receiving', L.UNITS, 0)),
    SUM(IF(L.PROCESS = 'receiving',
      L.TIEMPO_SISTEMICO + L.TIEMPO_NO_SISTEMICO + L.TND + L.EXTENDED_IDLE_TIME, 0))
  )                                                                         AS NETA_RECEIVING,

  -- Neta Checkin
  SAFE_DIVIDE(
    SUM(IF(L.PROCESS = 'checkin', L.UNITS, 0)),
    SUM(IF(L.PROCESS = 'checkin',
      L.TIEMPO_SISTEMICO + L.TIEMPO_NO_SISTEMICO + L.TND + L.EXTENDED_IDLE_TIME, 0))
  )                                                                         AS NETA_CHECKIN,

  -- Neta DCI
  SAFE_DIVIDE(
    SUM(IF(L.PROCESS = 'direct_checkin', L.UNITS, 0)),
    SUM(IF(L.PROCESS = 'direct_checkin',
      L.TIEMPO_SISTEMICO + L.TIEMPO_NO_SISTEMICO + L.TND + L.EXTENDED_IDLE_TIME, 0))
  )                                                                         AS NETA_DCI,

  -- Neta Putaway
  SAFE_DIVIDE(
    SUM(IF(L.PROCESS = 'putaway', L.UNITS, 0)),
    SUM(IF(L.PROCESS = 'putaway',
      L.TIEMPO_SISTEMICO + L.TIEMPO_NO_SISTEMICO + L.TND + L.EXTENDED_IDLE_TIME, 0))
  )                                                                         AS NETA_PUTAWAY,

  -- TPH CH + DCI
  SAFE_DIVIDE(
    SUM(IF(L.PROCESS IN ('checkin','direct_checkin'), L.UNITS, 0)),
    SUM(IF(L.PROCESS IN ('checkin','direct_checkin'),
      L.TIEMPO_SISTEMICO + L.TIEMPO_NO_SISTEMICO + L.TND + L.EXTENDED_IDLE_TIME, 0))
  )                                                                         AS TPH_CH_DCI,

  -- TPH Putaway
  SAFE_DIVIDE(
    SUM(IF(L.PROCESS = 'putaway', L.UNITS, 0)),
    SUM(IF(L.PROCESS = 'putaway',
      L.TIEMPO_SISTEMICO + L.TIEMPO_NO_SISTEMICO + L.TND + L.EXTENDED_IDLE_TIME, 0))
  )                                                                         AS TPH_PUTAWAY,

  -- Share DCI
  SAFE_DIVIDE(
    SUM(IF(L.PROCESS = 'direct_checkin', L.UNITS, 0)),
    SUM(IF(L.PROCESS IN ('checkin','direct_checkin'), L.UNITS, 0))
  ) * 100                                                                   AS SHARE_DCI,

  -- Targets
  MAX(IF(L.PROCESS = 'putaway',        L.TARGET_AREA_PNET,                NULL)) AS TARGET_INP,
  MAX(IF(L.PROCESS = 'receiving',      L.TARGET_PROCESS_NET_PRODUCTIVITY,  NULL)) AS TARGET_NETA_RECEIVING,
  MAX(IF(L.PROCESS = 'checkin',        L.TARGET_PROCESS_NET_PRODUCTIVITY,  NULL)) AS TARGET_NETA_CHECKIN,
  MAX(IF(L.PROCESS = 'direct_checkin', L.TARGET_PROCESS_NET_PRODUCTIVITY,  NULL)) AS TARGET_NETA_DCI,
  MAX(IF(L.PROCESS = 'putaway',        L.TARGET_PROCESS_NET_PRODUCTIVITY,  NULL)) AS TARGET_NETA_PUTAWAY

FROM `your-project.source.OPERATOR_PRODUCTIVITY` L
JOIN SEMANA S
  ON DATE(L.START_DATE) BETWEEN S.semana_inicio AND S.semana_fin
WHERE L.LOGISTIC_CENTER_ID = 'CD-01'
  AND L.AREA = 'inbound'
  AND DATE(L.START_DATE) >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 28 DAY)
  AND DATE(L.START_DATE) < CURRENT_DATE()
GROUP BY S.semana_fiscal, FECHA
ORDER BY FECHA DESC

WITH
SEMANA AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC(d, WEEK(SUNDAY)) AS semana_inicio,
    DATE_ADD(DATE_TRUNC(d, WEEK(SUNDAY)), INTERVAL 6 DAY) AS semana_fin,
    CONCAT('W', LPAD(CAST(DATE_DIFF(DATE_TRUNC(d, WEEK(SUNDAY)), DATE '2025-12-28', WEEK) + 1 AS STRING), 2, '0'),
      '-', CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d) AS STRING)) AS semana_fiscal
  FROM UNNEST(GENERATE_DATE_ARRAY(
    DATE_TRUNC(DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 28 DAY), WEEK(SUNDAY)),
    DATE_TRUNC(CURRENT_DATE(), WEEK(SUNDAY)),
    INTERVAL 1 WEEK
  )) AS d
),
SLA_D AS (
  SELECT
    DATE(START_DATE)                              AS FECHA,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(NUMERATOR, DENOMINATOR)           AS SLA_PCT,
    NUMERATOR                                     AS SLA_NUMERATOR,
    DENOMINATOR                                   AS SLA_DENOMINATOR
  FROM `your-project.source.INBOUND_SLA`
  WHERE WAREHOUSE_ID = 'CD-01'
    AND DATE(START_DATE) >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 28 DAY)
    AND DATE(START_DATE) < CURRENT_DATE()
),
REA_D AS (
  SELECT
    DATE(R.FECHA_REAPERTURA)                      AS FECHA,
    SUM(IF(R.ESTADO_EXC = 'FUERA DE 48h', 1, 0)) AS REAPERTURAS_FUERA_SLA,
    MAX(I.INB)                                    AS INB_TOTALES,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(
      SUM(IF(R.ESTADO_EXC = 'FUERA DE 48h', 1, 0)),
      MAX(I.INB)
    )                                             AS PCT_REAPERTURAS
  FROM `your-project.cx.REOPENINGS` R
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
      DATE(INB_RECEIVED_DATETIME) AS FECHA,
      COUNT(DISTINCT INBOUND_ID)  AS INB
    FROM `your-project.cx.INBOUND_CONTACTS_AGG`
    WHERE WAREHOUSE = 'CD-01'
      AND DATE(INB_RECEIVED_DATETIME) >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 28 DAY)
    GROUP BY 1
  ) I ON I.FECHA = DATE(R.FECHA_REAPERTURA)
  WHERE R.WAREHOUSE = 'CD-01'
    AND DATE(R.FECHA_REAPERTURA) >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 28 DAY)
    AND DATE(R.FECHA_REAPERTURA) < CURRENT_DATE()
    AND R.ESTADO_EXC = 'FUERA DE 48h'
  GROUP BY 1
),
DPMO_CRUCE_D AS (
  SELECT
    DATE(d.DATE_FINISH)                           AS FECHA,
    ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(COUNT(1), MAX(p.INBOUND_SKU)) * 1000000, 0) AS DPMO_CRUCE
  FROM `your-project.cx.SKU_CLAIMS` d
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
      DATE(MIN_ARRIVAL_DATETIME_TZ) AS FECHA_INB,
      COUNT(INBOUND_SKU)            AS INBOUND_SKU
    FROM `your-project.cx.SKU_PROCESSED`
    WHERE WAREHOUSE = 'CD-01'
    GROUP BY 1
  ) p ON DATE(d.DATE_FINISH) = p.FECHA_INB
  WHERE d.WAREHOUSE = 'CD-01'
    AND d.CULPABILIDADE = 'ERROR OPERATIVO'
    AND d.CDU_GROUP IN ('CRUCE SKU','CRUCE IS')
    AND DATE(d.DATE_FINISH) >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 28 DAY)
    AND DATE(d.DATE_FINISH) < CURRENT_DATE()
  GROUP BY 1
),
DPMO_FALT_D AS (
  SELECT
    DATE(d.DATE_FINISH)                           AS FECHA,
    ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(
      COUNT(IF(d.REASON NOT IN ('SIN REAPERTURA','SIN REAPERTURA - FPP'), d.SKU, NULL)),
      MAX(p.INBOUND_SKU)
    ) * 1000000, 0)                               AS DPMO_FALTANTE
  FROM `your-project.cx.SKU_CLAIMS` d
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
      DATE(MIN_ARRIVAL_DATETIME_TZ) AS FECHA_INB,
      COUNT(INBOUND_SKU)            AS INBOUND_SKU
    FROM `your-project.cx.SKU_PROCESSED`
    WHERE WAREHOUSE = 'CD-01'
    GROUP BY 1
  ) p ON DATE(d.DATE_FINISH) = p.FECHA_INB
  WHERE d.WAREHOUSE = 'CD-01'
    AND d.CULPABILIDADE = 'ERROR OPERATIVO'
    AND d.CDU_GROUP = 'FALTANTES'
    AND DATE(d.DATE_FINISH) >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 28 DAY)
    AND DATE(d.DATE_FINISH) < CURRENT_DATE()
  GROUP BY 1
),
CR_D AS (
  SELECT
    DATE(DATA_ACONTECIMENTO)                      AS FECHA,
    SUM(CX_CASE_ID)                               AS SUM_CX_CASE_ID,
    SUM(ENVIOS)                                   AS SUM_ENVIOS,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(CX_CASE_ID), SUM(ENVIOS))     AS CONTACT_RATE
  FROM `your-project.cx.CONTACT_RATE`
  WHERE WAREHOUSE = 'CD-01'
    AND DATE(DATA_ACONTECIMENTO) >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 28 DAY)
    AND DATE(DATA_ACONTECIMENTO) < CURRENT_DATE()
  GROUP BY 1
),
TEO_D AS (
  SELECT
    DATE                                          AS FECHA,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(
      SUM(IF(PROCESS = 'inbound audit', UNITS_TEO_INB, 0)),
      SUM(UNITS_GNP)
    )                                             AS TEO_INBOUND_AUDIT
  FROM `your-project.source.TEO_SUMMARY`
  WHERE WAREHOUSE_ID = 'CD-01'
    AND SITE_ID = 'MLC'
    AND DATE >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 28 DAY)
    AND DATE < CURRENT_DATE()
  GROUP BY 1
),
-- AUD_D CORREGIDO: DPMO = ERROR_UNITS / UNID * 1.000.000
AUD_D AS (
  SELECT
    DATE(A.FBM_CREATED_DATE)                      AS FECHA,
    SUM(A.ERROR_UNITS)                            AS ERROR_UNITS,
    MAX(P.Unid)                                   AS UNID,
    ROUND(
      SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(A.ERROR_UNITS), MAX(P.Unid)) * 1000000, 0
    )                                             AS INBOUND_AUDIT
  FROM `your-project.source.INBOUND_AUDIT` A
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
      DATE(START_DATE)  AS FECHA,
      SUM(UNITS)        AS Unid
    FROM `your-project.source.EMPLOYEE_ATTRIBUTES`
    WHERE LOGISTIC_CENTER_ID = 'CD-01'
      AND PROCESS    = 'inbound'
      AND SUBPROCESS = 'putaway'
      AND START_DATE >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 28 DAY)
    GROUP BY 1
  ) P ON P.FECHA = DATE(A.FBM_CREATED_DATE)
  WHERE A.WAREHOUSE_ID = 'CD-01'
    AND DATE(A.FBM_CREATED_DATE) >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 28 DAY)
    AND DATE(A.FBM_CREATED_DATE) < CURRENT_DATE()
  GROUP BY 1
)

SELECT
  S.semana_fiscal,
  SLA_D.FECHA,
  SLA_D.SLA_PCT,
  SLA_D.SLA_NUMERATOR,
  SLA_D.SLA_DENOMINATOR,
  REA_D.REAPERTURAS_FUERA_SLA,
  REA_D.INB_TOTALES,
  REA_D.PCT_REAPERTURAS,
  DPMO_CRUCE_D.DPMO_CRUCE,
  DPMO_FALT_D.DPMO_FALTANTE,
  CR_D.CONTACT_RATE,
  CR_D.SUM_CX_CASE_ID,
  CR_D.SUM_ENVIOS,
  TEO_D.TEO_INBOUND_AUDIT,
  AUD_D.INBOUND_AUDIT
FROM SLA_D
JOIN SEMANA S
  ON SLA_D.FECHA BETWEEN S.semana_inicio AND S.semana_fin
LEFT JOIN REA_D
  ON REA_D.FECHA        = SLA_D.FECHA
LEFT JOIN DPMO_CRUCE_D
  ON DPMO_CRUCE_D.FECHA = SLA_D.FECHA
LEFT JOIN DPMO_FALT_D
  ON DPMO_FALT_D.FECHA  = SLA_D.FECHA
LEFT JOIN CR_D
  ON CR_D.FECHA         = SLA_D.FECHA
LEFT JOIN TEO_D
  ON TEO_D.FECHA        = SLA_D.FECHA
LEFT JOIN AUD_D
  ON AUD_D.FECHA        = SLA_D.FECHA
ORDER BY SLA_D.FECHA DESC

WITH
SEMANA AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC(d, WEEK(SUNDAY))                                             AS semana_inicio,
    DATE_ADD(DATE_TRUNC(d, WEEK(SUNDAY)), INTERVAL 6 DAY)                  AS semana_fin,
    CONCAT('W', LPAD(CAST(DATE_DIFF(DATE_TRUNC(d, WEEK(SUNDAY)),
      DATE '2025-12-28', WEEK) + 1 AS STRING), 2, '0'),
      '-', CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d) AS STRING))                           AS semana_fiscal
  FROM UNNEST(GENERATE_DATE_ARRAY(
    DATE_TRUNC(DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 28 DAY), WEEK(SUNDAY)),
    DATE_TRUNC(CURRENT_DATE(), WEEK(SUNDAY)),
    INTERVAL 1 WEEK
  )) AS d
),
SKU AS (
  SELECT
    INVENTORY_ID,
    CASE WHEN FLAG_TOTABLE = TRUE THEN 'TOTEABLE' ELSE 'NO TOTEABLE' END   AS FLAG_TOTEABLE,
    COALESCE(
      ITE_VOLUMEN,
      CASE
        WHEN ITE_HEIGHT > 0 AND ITE_LENGTH > 0 AND ITE_WIDTH > 0
        THEN ITE_HEIGHT * ITE_LENGTH * ITE_WIDTH / 1000.0
        ELSE NULL
      END
    )                                                                       AS V_LITROS
  FROM `your-project.source.SKU_DETAILS`
  WHERE LOGISTIC_CENTER_ID = 'CD-01'
    AND SIT_SITE_ID        = 'MLC'
  QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
    PARTITION BY INVENTORY_ID
    ORDER BY (ITE_VOLUMEN IS NOT NULL) DESC, (ITE_HEIGHT IS NOT NULL) DESC
  ) = 1
),
OPS AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(OPERATOR_ID AS STRING)  AS OPERATOR_ID,
    DATE(START_DATE)             AS FECHA,
    PROCESS                      AS PROCESO
  FROM `your-project.source.OPERATOR_PRODUCTIVITY`
  WHERE AREA               = 'inbound'
    AND PROCESS            IN ('checkin','direct_checkin')
    AND LOGISTIC_CENTER_ID = 'CD-01'
    AND DATE(START_DATE)   >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 28 DAY)
    AND DATE(START_DATE)   < CURRENT_DATE()
),
VOL_CHK AS (
  SELECT
    'checkin'                                                               AS PROCESO,
    DATE(`your-project.udf.FN_TIMEZONE`('MLC', m.AUD_INS_DTTM)) AS FECHA,
    ROUND(SUM(m.FBM_QUANTITY * s.V_LITROS), 1)                             AS VOL_L_TOTAL,
    ROUND(SUM(IF(IFNULL(s.FLAG_TOTEABLE,'NO TOTEABLE') = 'TOTEABLE',
      m.FBM_QUANTITY * s.V_LITROS, NULL)), 1)                              AS VOL_L_TOTEABLE,
    ROUND(SUM(IF(IFNULL(s.FLAG_TOTEABLE,'NO TOTEABLE') = 'NO TOTEABLE',
      m.FBM_QUANTITY * s.V_LITROS, NULL)), 1)                              AS VOL_L_NO_TOTEABLE,
    SUM(IF(IFNULL(s.FLAG_TOTEABLE,'NO TOTEABLE') = 'TOTEABLE',
      m.FBM_QUANTITY, 0))                                                  AS UDS_TOTEABLE,
    SUM(IF(IFNULL(s.FLAG_TOTEABLE,'NO TOTEABLE') = 'NO TOTEABLE',
      m.FBM_QUANTITY, 0))                                                  AS UDS_NO_TOTEABLE,
    SUM(m.FBM_QUANTITY)                                                    AS UDS_TOTALES
  FROM `your-project.source.STOCK_MOVEMENTS` m
  INNER JOIN OPS ops
    ON  ops.OPERATOR_ID = CAST(m.FBM_USER_ID AS STRING)
    AND ops.FECHA = DATE(`your-project.udf.FN_TIMEZONE`('MLC', m.AUD_INS_DTTM))
    AND ops.PROCESO = 'checkin'
  LEFT JOIN SKU s ON s.INVENTORY_ID = m.INVENTORY_ID
  WHERE m.WAREHOUSE_ID       = 'CD-01'
    AND m.FBM_REASON_PROCESS = 'inbound'
    AND m.ADDRESS_FROM       IS NULL
    AND m.ADDRESS_TO         LIKE 'MU-%'
    AND m.AUD_INS_DTTM >= DATETIME(TIMESTAMP(DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 28 DAY), 'America/Santiago'))
    AND m.AUD_INS_DTTM <  DATETIME(TIMESTAMP(CURRENT_DATE(), 'America/Santiago'))
  GROUP BY FECHA
),
VOL_DCI AS (
  SELECT
    'direct_checkin'                                                        AS PROCESO,
    DATE(`your-project.udf.FN_TIMEZONE`('MLC', m.AUD_INS_DTTM)) AS FECHA,
    ROUND(SUM(m.FBM_QUANTITY * s.V_LITROS), 1)                             AS VOL_L_TOTAL,
    ROUND(SUM(IF(IFNULL(s.FLAG_TOTEABLE,'NO TOTEABLE') = 'TOTEABLE',
      m.FBM_QUANTITY * s.V_LITROS, NULL)), 1)                              AS VOL_L_TOTEABLE,
    ROUND(SUM(IF(IFNULL(s.FLAG_TOTEABLE,'NO TOTEABLE') = 'NO TOTEABLE',
      m.FBM_QUANTITY * s.V_LITROS, NULL)), 1)                              AS VOL_L_NO_TOTEABLE,
    SUM(IF(IFNULL(s.FLAG_TOTEABLE,'NO TOTEABLE') = 'TOTEABLE',
      m.FBM_QUANTITY, 0))                                                  AS UDS_TOTEABLE,
    SUM(IF(IFNULL(s.FLAG_TOTEABLE,'NO TOTEABLE') = 'NO TOTEABLE',
      m.FBM_QUANTITY, 0))                                                  AS UDS_NO_TOTEABLE,
    SUM(m.FBM_QUANTITY)                                                    AS UDS_TOTALES
  FROM `your-project.source.STOCK_MOVEMENTS` m
  INNER JOIN OPS ops
    ON  ops.OPERATOR_ID = CAST(m.FBM_USER_ID AS STRING)
    AND ops.FECHA = DATE(`your-project.udf.FN_TIMEZONE`('MLC', m.AUD_INS_DTTM))
    AND ops.PROCESO = 'direct_checkin'
  LEFT JOIN SKU s ON s.INVENTORY_ID = m.INVENTORY_ID
  WHERE m.WAREHOUSE_ID       = 'CD-01'
    AND m.FBM_REASON_PROCESS = 'inbound'
    AND m.ADDRESS_FROM       IS NULL
    AND m.ADDRESS_TO         LIKE 'MU-%'
    AND m.AUD_INS_DTTM >= DATETIME(TIMESTAMP(DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 28 DAY), 'America/Santiago'))
    AND m.AUD_INS_DTTM <  DATETIME(TIMESTAMP(CURRENT_DATE(), 'America/Santiago'))
  GROUP BY FECHA
),
VOL_PA AS (
  SELECT
    'putaway'                                                               AS PROCESO,
    DATE(m.FBM_CREATED_DATE)                                               AS FECHA,
    ROUND(SUM(m.FBM_QUANTITY * s.V_LITROS), 1)                             AS VOL_L_TOTAL,
    ROUND(SUM(IF(IFNULL(s.FLAG_TOTEABLE,'NO TOTEABLE') = 'TOTEABLE',
      m.FBM_QUANTITY * s.V_LITROS, NULL)), 1)                              AS VOL_L_TOTEABLE,
    ROUND(SUM(IF(IFNULL(s.FLAG_TOTEABLE,'NO TOTEABLE') = 'NO TOTEABLE',
      m.FBM_QUANTITY * s.V_LITROS, NULL)), 1)                              AS VOL_L_NO_TOTEABLE,
    SUM(IF(IFNULL(s.FLAG_TOTEABLE,'NO TOTEABLE') = 'TOTEABLE',
      m.FBM_QUANTITY, 0))                                                  AS UDS_TOTEABLE,
    SUM(IF(IFNULL(s.FLAG_TOTEABLE,'NO TOTEABLE') = 'NO TOTEABLE',
      m.FBM_QUANTITY, 0))                                                  AS UDS_NO_TOTEABLE,
    SUM(m.FBM_QUANTITY)                                                    AS UDS_TOTALES
  FROM `your-project.source.STOCK_MOVEMENTS` m
  LEFT JOIN SKU s ON s.INVENTORY_ID = m.INVENTORY_ID
  WHERE m.WAREHOUSE_ID       = 'CD-01'
    AND m.FBM_REASON_PROCESS = 'put_away'
    AND DATE(m.FBM_CREATED_DATE) >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 28 DAY)
    AND DATE(m.FBM_CREATED_DATE) <  CURRENT_DATE()
    AND m.FBM_QUANTITY > 0
  GROUP BY FECHA
),
VOL_ALL AS (
  SELECT * FROM VOL_CHK
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM VOL_DCI
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM VOL_PA
)
SELECT
  S.semana_fiscal,
  V.FECHA,
  V.PROCESO,
  V.UDS_TOTALES,
  V.UDS_TOTEABLE,
  V.UDS_NO_TOTEABLE,
  V.VOL_L_TOTAL,
  V.VOL_L_TOTEABLE,
  V.VOL_L_NO_TOTEABLE,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(V.UDS_TOTEABLE, V.UDS_TOTALES) * 100, 1)              AS PCT_TOTEABLE,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(V.VOL_L_TOTAL, V.UDS_TOTALES), 3)                     AS VOL_POND_TOTAL
FROM VOL_ALL V
JOIN SEMANA S
  ON V.FECHA BETWEEN S.semana_inicio AND S.semana_fin
ORDER BY V.FECHA DESC, V.PROCESO

WITH SEMANA AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC(d, WEEK(SUNDAY))                                             AS semana_inicio,
    DATE_ADD(DATE_TRUNC(d, WEEK(SUNDAY)), INTERVAL 6 DAY)                  AS semana_fin,
    CONCAT('W', LPAD(CAST(DATE_DIFF(DATE_TRUNC(d, WEEK(SUNDAY)),
      DATE '2025-12-28', WEEK) + 1 AS STRING), 2, '0'),
      '-', CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d) AS STRING))                           AS semana_fiscal
  FROM UNNEST(GENERATE_DATE_ARRAY(
    DATE_TRUNC(DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 28 DAY), WEEK(SUNDAY)),
    DATE_TRUNC(CURRENT_DATE(), WEEK(SUNDAY)),
    INTERVAL 1 WEEK
  )) AS d
)
SELECT
  S.semana_fiscal,
  DATE(A.START_DATE)                                                        AS FECHA,
  SUM(CASE
    WHEN A.HIRING_DATE = false
    AND A.ROL IN ('rep','team_lead')
    AND A.AT_NET IS NOT NULL
    THEN A.NET_WORK_DURATION ELSE 0
  END)                                                                      AS AT_NUMERADOR,
  SUM(CASE
    WHEN A.HIRING_DATE = false
    AND A.ROL IN ('rep','team_lead')
    AND A.AT_NET IS NOT NULL
    THEN A.TARGET_DURATION ELSE 0
  END)                                                                      AS AT_DENOMINADOR,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(
    SUM(CASE
      WHEN A.HIRING_DATE = false
      AND A.ROL IN ('rep','team_lead')
      AND A.AT_NET IS NOT NULL
      THEN A.NET_WORK_DURATION ELSE 0
    END),
    SUM(CASE
      WHEN A.HIRING_DATE = false
      AND A.ROL IN ('rep','team_lead')
      AND A.AT_NET IS NOT NULL
      THEN A.TARGET_DURATION ELSE 0
    END)
  )                                                                         AS AT_PCT
FROM `your-project.source.AVAILABLE_TIME` A
JOIN SEMANA S
  ON DATE(A.START_DATE) BETWEEN S.semana_inicio AND S.semana_fin
WHERE A.LOGISTIC_CENTER_ID = 'CD-01'
  AND A.AREA               = 'inbound_fbm'
  AND DATE(A.START_DATE)   >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 28 DAY)
  AND DATE(A.START_DATE)   < CURRENT_DATE()
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY FECHA DESC
